sourceTitle: Outpace automated cyber threats with security built for nonstop defense.
originalTitle: Outpace automated cyber threats with security built for nonstop defense.
author: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG)

blocks.text: Imagine a hacker that doesn’t eat, sleep, or get tired, and never stops searching for a way in.
blocks.zh: 想象一个不吃不睡、不知疲倦的黑客，永不停歇地寻找入侵途径。
blocks.en: Imagine a hacker that doesn’t eat, sleep, or get tired, and never stops searching for a way in.

blocks.text: According to the latest AI Threat Tracker report, bad actors are now using autonomous LLM frameworks to continuously scan software updates, figure out what flaw was patched, and build an attack for it — all without human involvement.
blocks.zh: 根据最新的 AI Threat Tracker 报告，恶意行为者现在正使用自主 LLM 框架持续扫描软件更新，弄清修补了什么漏洞，并针对该漏洞构建攻击——全程无需人类参与。
blocks.en: According to the latest AI Threat Tracker report, bad actors are now using autonomous LLM frameworks to continuously scan software updates, figure out what flaw was patched, and build an attack for it — all without human involvement.

blocks.text: Defending against machine-speed threats at human speed isn’t feasible. That's why we're helping defenders rethink security in the agentic era with Google AI Threat Defense, which combines Gemini and other frontier models, Wiz’s context and prioritization, CodeMender’s automated patching, and Mandiant’s expertise to continuously find and fix flaws before attackers can exploit them.
blocks.zh: 以人类速度防御机器速度的威胁并不可行。因此，我们正在通过 Google AI Threat Defense 帮助防御者重新思考智能体驱动时代的安全，该方案结合了 Gemini 和其他前沿模型、Wiz 的上下文与优先级排序、CodeMender 的自动修补以及 Mandiant 的专业知识，以持续发现并修复漏洞，防患于攻击者利用之前。
blocks.en: Defending against machine-speed threats at human speed isn’t feasible. That's why we're helping defenders rethink security in the agentic era with Google AI Threat Defense, which combines Gemini and other frontier models, Wiz’s context and prioritization, CodeMender’s automated patching, and Mandiant’s expertise to continuously find and fix flaws before attackers can exploit them.

blocks.text: Read the full report on the Google Cloud Threat Intelligence blog.
blocks.zh: 在 Google Cloud Threat Intelligence 博客上阅读完整报告。
blocks.en: Read the full report on the Google Cloud Threat Intelligence blog.
